title: Run at most one dynamic-retrieval variant live if its proxy justifies it
description:
## Purpose

Run at most one dynamic-retrieval variant live, only if the proxy justified it.

## Scope

The chosen D variant: 300 labeled leave-one-out answers + paper-600 answers, then score D and A-c+F+D (head-only, not an independent steering trajectory).

## Cost cap

≈900 few-shot requests ≈ $0.60; **hard cap 900 Jev requests**; counts toward the 7,500 cumulative ledger. Skip entirely if S2 chose none.

## Definition of done

Results added to the unified results page, or a note here that no variant qualified. Cost as above.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §5.2, §5.3 (Optional: one D variant live), §6 step 10.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Arm D built offline (e6ad9a7): run --final --arms D --retriever {embedding,bm25,lexical-v2,lexical-v1}. D = A-c's frozen rubric questions + per-item retrieved examples (4 per label, from the 300 labels; leave-one-out for labeled items; held-out IDs protected) in one Jev request per item + a refit head; scores paper-600 and compares with A-c+F, A-c, F, 0 from final-predictions.jsonl. Upper bound 300 + 600 = 900 requests per variant; cache keyed by the retrieval context fingerprint; outputs in run_dir/final-d/<variant>/final-d-summary.json. Not bundled (core ClassifierBundle records retrieval as null). Live commands prepared, NOT run: D-emb and D-bm25, each with its own ledger (ceiling 900, max-new 900) against var/unified-flywheel/phase2-live-seed1 (new files only). Note: the proxy gap is +2.3 points (embedding vs v1), under the design's 3-point bar, so running any variant live is an owner decision; the task's 'at most one' still applies unless the owner widens it.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done 2026-10-01: ran both variants live (owner dropped the proxy threshold; comparisons are only reported). paper-600, 900 Jev requests each, 0 failures: D-embedding acc 0.915 / Brier 0.065; D-BM25 0.898 / 0.074; vs A-c+F (default) 0.850 / 0.092. Results: studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md Addendum 3, studies/results/unified/phase3-d-*.json (b77df60). Retrieval stays optional; the fixed list stays the default.
